exclude.hero.video-loop/film-centred-lockup: Needs real graded footage. No model can make it, so the result is a gradient or an unverified stock clip under a flat veil, which hero.md names as the cheap version.
exclude.hero.video-loop/film-bottom-caption: Needs a real film with a finished poster frame. The fallback is a dark gradient with a pause button on nothing.
exclude.hero.video-loop/cinema-card: A 1200px film card is the whole first screen, and there is no footage to put in it. An empty poster reads as a placeholder.
exclude.hero.video-loop/reel-as-identity: Depends on a real reel of varied work cut every second. A generated page has no such body of work.
exclude.hero.video-loop/product-film: Needs studio footage of a real product. The fallback is a CSS object at poster scale, a measured Opus tell.
exclude.hero.video-loop/inset-reel: Needs real footage. Without it the framed-print gutter frames nothing.
exclude.hero.video-loop/texture-film: Needs liquid-metal or motion-blur footage. The fallback is an animated gradient, the wash this skill warns against.
exclude.hero.centered-with-product/video-tile-un: A play control needs a film behind it. Without one the tile is a fake control over a fake poster, which SKILL.md forbids as a picture that is not there.
exclude.hero.object-3d/seamless-render-on-page-g: Needs a real render at 60 to 80% of viewport width. hero.md says not to fake one in CSS, and the anti-patterns list procedural objects at poster scale.
exclude.hero.object-3d/object-beside-headline: Needs a real matte or iridescent render. The model fallback is a glossy gradient blob, which hero.md calls cheap.
exclude.hero.full-bleed-media/depth-layered-subj: Depends on a clean cut-out layer from a real photograph. A model cannot produce the overlap, so the effect collapses.
exclude.hero.type-only/giant-wordmark: Name at 150 to 450px, weight up to 900, on a flat field. This is the exact vibe-code-good trap in SKILL.md and the oversized-headline giveaway. Expressive briefs still get it.
exclude.hero.type-only/mark-plus-sentence: The row itself says it needs a known company and reads as unfinished otherwise. Every invented business here is unknown.
exclude.hero.type-only/stack-with-proof-row: Proof row of avatars, stars and numerals has no real source on an invented business. It matches the invented-proof entry: five stars beside an avatar stack in 6 of 16 GPT runs. No gold evidence.
exclude.hero.interactive-demo/signature-instrume: A strange instrument filling the hero is the hero toy tell, in 8 of 16 Opus pages, and a gimmick doing the job of design. Evidence is all expressive tier.
exclude.atmosphere.gradient-field/flat-colour-wo: Every section one saturated flat. This is the flat-field failure: 12 of 16 Opus pages against 5 of 147 gold. No gold evidence, unlike the false-alarm sites, which put real content in the colour.
exclude.atmosphere.pattern/organic-blob-fields: Organic blobs are in the anti-pattern catalogue, the atmosphere chapter calls a pale blob cheap, and the sibling blob row is marked dated. No gold evidence.
exclude.layout.composition-shift/product-as-page: The site dressed as an OS window is a metaphor costume, a SKILL.md giveaway. Evidence is PostHog pages plus one silver site.
exclude.layout.section-rhythm/scene-per-viewport: A 100vh image and one line per screen needs real film-grade imagery, and it is the one-sentence-per-screen failure when the imagery is weak.

atmosphere.light-surface-ladder/warm-ton.reason: Fine when the brief earns warmth, but the ladder slot has few rows, so it is dealt far above the 8% of gold pages on warm off-white. Warm ground is the model collapse: 81% of GPT-6 pages.

atmosphere.light-surface-ladder/cream-se.reason: Same collapse as the warm ladder. Together they reach about a third of simulated hands. The false alarm allows cream when chosen, so this is a weight, not a ban.

atmosphere.light-surface-ladder/flat-col.reason: Each section a single flat is the Opus habit, median 4 grounds against gold's 1 or 2. Few rows in this slot, so it is dealt often. Valid with a strict system.

hero.full-bleed-media/centred-lockup.reason: Flat overlay with centred white text is what hero.md calls the most generated hero. Real on Fred and La Table de Joakim, but only once the edges are added.

hero.full-bleed-media/giant-type-over-im.reason: A 15 to 20vw title lands at 216 to 288px, feeding the Opus H1 median near 130px. Real on A24 and Acne, and fine on a light weight over a strong image, so it should be a choice.

atmosphere.gradient-field/page-long-hue-.reason: A page-tall gradient with glass cards is a wash with no edge. The chapter says gradients fail when they fill the page, and only 7 of 66 rows do.

atmosphere.gradient-field/vertical-wash-.reason: A saturated hero wash is the classic overuse. Models build the two-stop version rather than the four to six stops the row needs.

surface.bento/gradient-per-tile-bento.reason: A gradient in every tile spends a once-only device six times, and the cheap version is the template bento with gradient thumbnails.

surface.glass-or-blur/glass-card-over-ph.reason: Glass cards are a SKILL.md giveaway and only 7 of 89 gold sites use glass at all. Legitimate over a rich photograph, as Hims does.

layout.full-bleed-break/solid-colour-sta.reason: A viewport of saturated colour with one sentence is the Opus flat field. Works once with grain and overlapping product, as on Inngest, and the row warns it otherwise reads as a poster.

layout.section-rhythm/butted-colour-bloc.reason: Five to seven grounds conflicts with layout's two or three and reads as a sample book in cheap form. Real on Framework and Analogue with a strict system.
